notifications.danger: The product poses a risk of injuries (accident) because during regular brake fluid replacement or brake bleeding operations, it may be possible for a seal in the brake master cylinder to become deformed resulting in a small brake fluid leak. If the brake fluid level reduces significantly, the brake warning light and low brake fluid warning light will be activated in the instrument panel. If the vehicle is continued to be driven in this condition, the brake pedal stroke will gradually increase. Finally, if the above symptoms are ignored, one of the brake circuits may fail. Although the remaining circuit provides sufficient brake force to stop the vehicle, the stopping distance will increase.

notifications.product: Passenger car - Volvo S80, V70, XC70, XC60
notifications.danger: The product poses a risk of injuries because the engine cooling fan may permanently stop working due to a software error in the Fan Control Module (FCM). If the fan stops it may cause reduced Air Condition (AC) performance and the driver will normally be informed of the increased coolant temperature by a yellow information lamp and the following written message: "reduce speed". However, if the engine temperature continues to rise, a red warning lamp will light up and text instructions will indicate that the car should be stopped safely. In this specific failure mode, the deviation may lead to a rapid increase in coolant temperature and the driver may not notice the indication lamps and the text messages. The situation could result in boiling coolant, loss of coolant and eventually engine damage or engine break down, which may lead to accidents.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer. Date of entry into force: Unknown

If a screw is missing, the head airbag might not unfold properly and the occupants of the car would not be protected to the same degree in the event of an accident.
The product (Vehicle type GG3) also poses a risk of injuries because the screws in the mechanism assembling side airbags and seats belts may be missing. The failure may lead to a risk of injuries due to malfunctioning of airbags and seat belts during the accident.

notifications.product: Passenger car - Seat belt ELR (Emergency Locking Retractor)
notifications.type_numberOfModel: Passenger car, model Jazz (model codes: GG2 and GG3)
notifications.danger: The product poses a risk of injuries because the locating bolt was not fitted initially and was then missed as the installed seat belt obscured the locating bolt hole from the operator's view. If the locating bolt is missing, the seatbelt's Emergency Locking Retractor (ELR) can move during usage potentially loosening the ELR mounting bolt. If this should happen, the ELR can move outside its intended angle limit preventing correct operation of the locking function. If the seat belt retractor bolt is missing, correct operation of the seat belt locking mechanism cannot be guaranteed. This may reduce protection in case of an impact, thus increasing the risk of injury.

The product poses a risk of fire because the cover of the electrical cooling fan control unit does not meet requirements and may lead to water penetration and an electrical malfunction in the control unit. In the worst case scenario, this condition may cause a short circuit and local overheating of the control unit. Should this occur, a fire could start in the engine bay. Since the fan is permanently connected to battery voltage, a fire could also start when the vehicle is parked - both in a key-on and key-off position.

notifications.brand: 1. Electric scooter: unknown;2. Battery charger: TUOS
notifications.type_numberOfModel:
1. Scooter: TDR-85Z, TDR-99Z, TDR81Z, TDR-09Z, TDR80Z;
2. Battery charger: DS-MC-48V II
notifications.danger:
The product poses a risk of:
1. Electric shock since:
- the mains cable is not fixed in the printed circuit independently from soldering,
- the live conductors may come into contact with low voltage parts or opposite pole,
- the socket applied at the output part of the battery charger is similar to the ones used at connections of other appliances, thus the plug under the seat can easily be connected to mains supply (230 V).
2. Explosion and fire since:
- the batteries can be directly connected to the mains supply (230 V) through the plug placed under the seat and the battery unit;
- there are no diaphragms applied at soldering, therefore the conductors may cause defects in the regulatory circuit,
- the batteries cannot be fixed properly in the battery space, their cables may be damaged and they can detach from terminals which could cause a short circuit.
The product does not comply with the relevant European standard EN 60335.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator to whom the measure(s) were ordered: Other Category of measure(s): Withdrawal from the market ordered by the authorities. Date of entry into force: Unknown
notifications.description: The plastic covering of the electric scooter is fixed to an iron frame. The electric motor is placed into the rear wheel. The battery charger can be connected to the plug placed under the seat. The battery unit can be found under the footrest and includes 4 rechargeable lead acid batteries. Once removed, the battery unit can also be connected directly to the charger. The plastic housing of the battery charger is supplied with ventilation holes and includes all electronic parts. Main components of the electric scooter: plug under the seat for connecting the charger (10A 250V), cable in the battery space (2 x 1.5mm2 227 IEC 300/500V, WIRE & CABLE FACTORY), socket in the battery space (SY-007 A 027262), plug in battery unit (15A 250V~, SS-7B) and other parts. Main parts of the battery charger: mains plug with side earth contacts (16A 250V~ DJ-012 DONG JU); mains cable (H05VV-F 3G 0.75mm2 227IEC 53(RVV) 300/500V 2002010105021011 DONGJU); output cable (48V - ZHEN JIANG SHI HUACHENG DIAN ZI QI CAI YOU XIAN GONG SI 227 IEC52(RVV) 2 x 0.5mm2 300/300V); socket (10A250V~ Y3-EA005633); printed circuit (DS-MC-17 HUAXIA), and other components. The product poses a risk of injuries because in the event of inappropriate handling, such as pulling roughly, hitting objects while manoeuvring, or if the motorcycle falls over, the hand protector on the handlebar controls can twist. It could then touch the handbrake or clutch control causing brake or clutch malfunction. In addition, if the twisted hand protector lightly touches and operates the handbrake control, the brake linings may touch the brake disc and the resulting heat generation would cause the brake pressure to build up which could slow down the front wheel, even so far as to block it.

notifications.danger: The product poses a risk of injuries because the frame may crack at the lower rear cross-member. The lower rear engine mount has a threaded collar designed to eliminate clearance between the frame and the engine cases before the engine mounting bolt is installed and tightened. On the affected units, the collar was tightened excessively which created stress across the lower cross-member. This cross-member, which carries significant rear suspension loads, can therefore crack as a result of heavy suspension loading, such as when encountering potholes or rough surfaces. Failure of the frame could result in the rear of the motorcycle collapsing and lead to an accident.

notifications.danger:
These products pose a risk of injuries due to :
- water (from rain or washing) entering the wiring from the right-hand side of the motor’s stop button, which accumulates inside the plastic cladding. The accumulated water can leak into the wires and seep into the accelerator’s position sensor. In cold climates, the water in the accelerator’s position sensor can freeze, thereby preventing the motor from decelerating after the accelerator has been released.
- corrosion and the resulting increase in resistance between the resistor and the terminal of the accelerator’s position sensor may cause the ECU to detect a fault in the accelerator’s position sensor. This may cause the indicator lights to activate or to fail to change in certain models.
notifications.measures:
Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer.
Date of entry into force: Unknown

notifications.danger: The product poses a risk of fire because if the terminal and wire are incorrectly inserted in the ACG stator plug, the resistance of the contact in the terminal exceeds the standard value necessary, generating heat in the connection and resulting in the separation of the two parts. Once separation occurs, the generation of heat accelerates, melting the plug, which causes the motor to stop or the vehicle to catch fire.
notifications.measures:

The product does not comply with the relevant standard ISO 6722.

This caused less tread length on the bolts, which in turn lead to an insufficient clamping force in the joint.

notifications.danger: The product poses a risk of injuries because there is a possibility of partial loss of the ABS functions after 3 to 5 seconds of setting due to an internal leak from the ESP isolation solenoid valve. This could result in partial and temporary loss of directional control of the vehicle and the ESP (electronic stability) function if braking is accompanied by activation of the ABS (wheel anti-blocking system). The ESP function sets the ABS to ensure the functioning of the wheel(s) which corrects the vehicle's trajectory. Functioning returns to normal when the brake pedal is released after braking. The conventional braking function (i.e. with no activation of the ABS) is not affected.

notifications.danger:
The product poses a risk of injuries because:
- the plastic containers of battery acid can leak, which would cause a hazard to the skin and eyes,
- the nut and bolt provided to hold the shock absorber in place do not fit together. If the bolt is unfastened and becomes loose, an accident could occur,
- the material of the saddle is stapled along the underside and many of these staples are loose and sharp,
- the chain drive near the operator’s left foot is only partially guarded, this may lead to a hazard due to catching of boot/shoelaces,
The product poses a risk of fire and burns because:
- there are two identical pipes in close proximity, either of which can be attached to the fuel valve,
- the fuel pipes are fastened by means of small metal clips. These are supplied loosely on the pipe, meaning they can easily be lost. This would lead to the fuel line being insecure,
- the driver’s legs are close to the engine and exhaust system, which may lead to burns.

notifications.danger: The product poses a risk of fire because certain vehicles were assembled with Electronic Control Modules (ECMs) that may contain a defective fan Field Effect Transistor (FET). The fan FET is an electrical component involved with the ATV’s cooling fan function. In most instances when the fan FET fails, the vehicle battery will drain and the vehicle will not start. In some instances, the defective fan FET can cause the ECM to fail and then overheat. If this were to occur, excessive heat could occur inside the ECM which could, in infrequent circumstances, progress to fire.

notifications.danger: The product poses a risk of injuries because the power steering hose may get in conflict with the engine cooling fan. This concern is due to an insufficient retaining clip. The insufficient basic design regarding fixation of the power steering hose enables it to come in direct contact with the rotating fan. The subsequent chafing on the hose will result in a sudden drainage of servo oil in the system and a loss of servo assistance. Since this will appear suddenly and without any relevant warnings to the driver, combined with the type of vehicle concerned, this condition poses an unreasonable risk to motor vehicle safety.

notifications.danger:
The product poses a risk of injuries due to possible loss of the glass panel of the sunroof.
Failure of either the left-side or right-side sunroof guide rail could cause the sunroof to become detached from its operating mechanism and bind. There might be a cracking noise if this condition occurs. If it does occur, the sunroof glass panel will remain attached to its frame, but further attempts to operate it will result in continued noise and abnormal operation due to the binding condition. If a vertical force is applied (for example, if the user is manually aiding the sunroof to close, or wind lift) the glass panel can become fully detached from the vehicle.

notifications.danger:
The product poses a risk of injuries because the inner cover of the casing for the throttle position sensor (TPS) may not be properly sealed to the outer cover, and allow damp to penetrate. The TPS can therefore produce incorrect signals, causing the following problems:
1.-The emission of exhaust gases may exceed the maximum permitted.
2.-At low speed, or when the vehicle is coming to a halt, engine deceleration is unstable and the engine may stall, following which it is difficult to restart.
There is therefore the risk of a traffic accident because, should the engine stop at low speed when a gear is engaged and the motorcycle is in movement, the rider may lose balance and fall, particularly bearing in mind the considerable weight of this kind of motorcycle.

notifications.danger:
The product poses a risk of injuries due to an internal leakage in the brake master cylinder. If affected, the driver may experience reduced performance when applying and maintaining force on the brake pedal.
Over time the capacity to brake will gradually deteriorate, forcing the driver to put more force on the brake pedal compared to when braking with an intact brake system. The deterioration will eventually result in a complete loss of the brake system function.

notifications.danger:
The product poses a risk of fire :
- due to fuel leakage when starting the machine. For this reason, it is not possible to measure noise, vibrations or temperature in hot areas.
- because the fuel shut-off is situated next to the carburettor and there are leaks in the joint between the fuel line and the tank. The fuel lines are in contact with the exhaust pipe.
The product poses a risk of injuries because :
- the machine is not equipped with a foot-rest.
- there is no stand enabling the machine to be stored in a stable position.
- the 'stop' command can become jammed and not work.
- the machine is not equipped with steering stops.
- the fuel lines are not type-approved and do not have the appropriate support brackets.
- there is insufficient protection in the area of the motor flywheel.
- there is no protection on the exhaust pipe on the machine.
The product poses a risk of cuts due to sharp edges on the plastic elements and welded seams of the machine.
The product does not comply with the Machinery Directive.

notifications.product: Motorcycles - Fuel tank air vent pipe
notifications.type_numberOfModel: Motorcycles, model CBR1000, model code SC57.
notifications.danger:
The product poses a risk of fire because the air vent pipe in the fuel tank resonates at a specific engine rotation speed and in some cases this may cause the air vent pipe to crack in the brazed portion of the air vent pipe in the bottom of the fuel tank. Construction of the fuel tank makes two different brazing methods for the air vent pipe, MIG brazing and flame brazing.
Only MIG brazed fuel tanks encounter high stress generated at the brazed area of the air vent pipe due to the shape of the brazing and cracking may occur due to fatigue, resulting in fuel leakage.
notifications.measures:

notifications.danger: This product poses a risk of injuries because the brake assistance vacuum may be reduced under cold start conditions. During engine warm up in low ambient temperatures, it is possible that the non return valve within the brake vacuum pump may intermittently stick, and by that not supply vacuum to the brake booster. If the condition occurs the driver may experience a hard brake pedal, due to the reduced brake vacuum in the brake booster. The brakes are still functioning, even if the brake vacuum assistance is reduced, but the brake pedal must be pressed harder to make up for the lack of brake vacuum assistance and in certain traffic conditions this may lead to an unsafe situation.

Cannondale has received 15 reports of the bicycle forks separating, including five reports of injuries including a broken collarbone, broken ribs and bruises. All accidents were reported in the US. So far, no accidents reported in Europe.

notifications.product: Passenger car – shift cable clip in Suzuki vehicles
notifications.danger: The affected vehicles are equipped with the gasoline engine and 5 speed manual transmission. Due to an improper shape of the shift cable clip that keeps the gearshift cable attached to the gearshift lever, the shift cable clip can contact the gearshift lever housing if excessive lateral force is applied when shifting to first gear. Repeated shifting in this manner can eventually cause the shift cable clip to break. If the shift cable clip breaks, the gearshift cable can become disconnected from gearshift control lever, resulting in loss of the ability to change transmission gears.

notifications.name: Mercedes-Benz Atego.
notifications.danger:
These vehicles can cause injuries because premature abrasion of the front-axle wheel bearings could cause the wheel to come off.
Polluted water may penetrate the wheel bearing from the front axle via the rear gasket and cause premature wear-out of the roller assemblies in the wheel bearings. Early symptoms of damage after the defect has occurred are optical warning indicators. Once the damage has progressed there are noises, changes in steering response, and a noticeable smell of overheated brake linings .
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the manufacturer. Date of entry into force: Unknown

notifications.name: Engine Harness in passenger cars.
notifications.danger: The affected vehicles may have a potential risk of damage on engine harness. Due to the insufficient protection of engine harness, it could interfere with timing belt cover bolt head. Then it can cause wiring harness abrasion by vibration and engine malfunction by short circuit. After certain period of usage, the above condition may cause wire harness overheat and burning.

notifications.product: Passenger car - steering system in Smart Fortwo
notifications.danger: The product poses a serious risk of injuries because during the assembly process by the supplier of the mechanical steering (Delphi) it could be that a circlip (Seeger retaining ring) is not correctly fitted in all cases, which means that a perfect fit of this circlip in the groove provided is not always guaranteed. In the worst case this could result in migration of the ball bearing including the steering shaft during steering. This would mean loss of the connection between the steering pinion and the steering rack. The front wheels are then no longer steerable.
notifications.measures:

notifications.danger:
The product poses a risk of fire and injuries because the fuel petcock valve mounting inserts may become loose from the fuel tank assembly due to an imperfect fit of the threads of the fuel petcock valve and fuel tank mounting area, respectively. If a brass mounting insert becomes loose or is pulled from the base of the fuel tank, a fuel leak may develop in the petcock valve mounting area.
This product does not comply with the Machinery Directive.

This may cause leaks at the ABC distribution line between the pressure supply valve unit and the front axle/rear axle distributor, leading to possible improper function of the ABC distributor.

notifications.danger: The product poses a serious risk of fire since engineering investigations have identified a small percentage of Maverick vehicles that may have missing or dislodged wire seals in the Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) Module connector. This condition could allow contamination to enter the module connector, creating a potential risk for an electrical short. An electrical short might cause an ABS malfunction that would illuminate the ABS warning light, and in extreme cases, the module may overheat resulting in a burning odour, smoke and/or fire.
notifications.measures:
Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer
Date of entry into force: Unknown
notifications.description: The recall concerns FORD MAVERICK vehicles produced from 1 May 2003 to 23 January 2004 (produced in Ohio) and from 22 October 1999 to 19 December 2003 (produced in Kansas City).

notifications.danger: This product poses a serious risk of fire because the Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) Module connector may have missing or dislodged wire seals. This can allow contamination to enter the ABS electrical connector and cause corrosion of the electrical terminals. The corrosion gradually may result in an ABS malfunction that causes illuminating the ABS warning indicator lamp, blowing of fuses, and in some rare instances smoking or melting of the electrical connector, and/or fire. This can occur either when the vehicle ignition switch is in the off position or while the vehicle is being operated.
notifications.measures:
Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer. Press release has been issued.

notifications.danger: Investigations carried out have shown that in the batch of ‘1.6L Duratorq TDCi 110 PS’ engines built into the Ford ‘Focus C-MAX’ vehicles in question, the oil feed holes between the cylinder head and the camshaft bearings may be misaligned, reducing the flow of oil to the camshaft bearings. Over time, this reduced oil flow could cause premature wear of the camshaft bearings and may also result in seizure of the engine without prior warning.

notifications.danger: This product poses a serious risk of injuries because it is equipped with rear windscreen washer/wipers and water can work its way into the wiper motor via the wiper arm spindle. If the water contains salt, which is normal under winter driving conditions, it can result in a short circuit and cause the motor to fail. In extreme cases, the short circuit can result in the wiper assembly overheating. The increased temperature can be high enough to melt the trim components in the area of the motor assembly.

This product poses a risk of injuries because some castings may have been produced with insufficient amount of material thickness in an area where the lower a-arm and ball-joint are attached to the front bearing carrier. If the attachment point for the lower a-arm and ball-joint were to fail as a result of reduced cross-section, the operator may lose control of the vehicle, possibly resulting in severe injury or death.
This product does not comply with the Machinery Directive. Two incidents without injuries reported by the UK and France.

notifications.product: Passenger car - DPF (Diesel Particulate Filter) system in Suzuki Grand Vitara
notifications.danger:
This vehicle poses a risk of injuries due to a possible loss of power.
The affected vehicles may pose a potential risk of damage to DPF (Diesel Particulate Filter) system. Due to the improper design of the intercooler and the intercooler inlet hose, the compressed air could leak and cause the improper ratio of air/fuel mixture. After certain period of usage, the above condition may cause excessive deposition of carbon particulate in DPF that could result in the overheating or melting of DPF and damage due to heat. In this case the warning lights on drivers control panel will illuminate and if the vehicle will not be driven to an authorised repair, loss of power will happen.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer Date of entry into force: Unknown

notifications.danger: This product poses a serious risk of injuries because investigations have shown that in certain riding conditions vibrations transmitted from the chassis to the rear brake hydraulic lines can create a phenomenon whereby gas is released from the brake fluid and collecting in pockets of gas in the hydraulic lines. Any pockets of gas within the hydraulic circuit of the rear brake will significantly reduce the effectiveness of the system and in extreme cases will render the rear brake inoperative.

notifications.danger: This product poses a serious risk of injuries because water, which turns into ice at low temperatures, can get into the Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) valve damaging the valve and making it leaky. The valve is located on the intake manifold and plays a key role in reducing unwanted engine emissions. When the valve is flawed it can cause excessive emissions of exhaust gases, engine's choking and stalling while accelerating and finally lowering efficiency of the braking system.

The parking brake cable end and parking brake shoe lever may be assembled incorrectly. There is a possibility that the parking cable brake end will detach from the parking brake shoe lever. In this situation the effectiveness of the parking brake will be lost.

notifications.danger: This product poses a serious risk of fire because in model saloon cars with heated seats, sports seats and “comfort” seats there is a possibility of a short circuit occurring in the heating mats of the seats because the tips of the wires are not sewn in correctly. The covers of the front seat backs can sustain burn damage.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer Date of entry into force: Unknown
notifications.description: Chassis numbers between: WVW ZZZ 9NZ 64 000 001-261502 and WVW ZZZ 9NZ 64000 001-163395 .Vehicles, model saloon car built between May 2005 and February 2007 .

notifications.danger: This product poses a serious risk of injuries because the speedometer cable on the units affected may break and prevent the speedometer displaying the speed. Inspection of a speedometer cable and a brake panel revealed a split in the outer lining material (PVC), with corrosion of the winding of the outer structure and the inner winding at the area of the split, causing the speedometer reel to seize up and break. Reproduction tests revealed that certain components of the grease applied to the sliding surface of the inner cable caused hardening of the outer lining material, which might then split. If water enters through the split, the winding of the outer body and the inner cable corrode and seize up. The speedometer then breaks down when the speedometer reel or inner cable break.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other Category of measure(s): Voluntary recall from consumers and corrective actions taken by the importer Date of entry into force: Unknown

notifications.danger: This product poses a risk of injuries because the welding process to manufacture the upper front shock tower brackets may not have achieved sufficient weld penetration in some instances. If insufficient weld penetration were to occur, there is a possibility that the upper shock mount could begin to separate at the welded joint(s). If a separation of the welded joint(s) were to occur, the most likely case would be that this occurs gradually. The ride height of the machine would gradually diminish as the location of the upper shock mount moved upwards. This can occur either the right or left side. A less likely possibility is that the shock mount falls suddenly. If this occurs, the rider could lose control of the machine, either due to a sudden change in the ride height of the machine or due to interference with steering mechanism. The product does not comply with the Machinery Directive.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the producer Date of entry into force: Unknown

notifications.danger:
Cause of an accident due to reduction of the braking ability of the motorbike.
On the affected motorcycles, air bubbles discharged from the brake fluid caused by vibrations in certain driving situations cause a rear brake malfunction in the brake system. Due to the modified routing and the shorter hoses, the hydraulic system is put out of tune and the brake fluid won’t emit gas. This could affect the braking ability of the motorcycle.
The ABS system and the front brake work properly, even if the rear brake may malfunction.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective action taken by the importer Date of entry into force: Unknown

notifications.danger: Some of the affected vehicles may contain a breather pipe that was not manufactured to specification. This may result in excessive swelling and cracking of the retaining grommet and subsequent detachment of the breather pipe from a connector tube. The vehicle may exhibit MIL illumination, fuel odour and drivability concerns such as hesitation, misfire, stalling, rough running or difficulty in starting (reasons for probable cause of accident). If the amount of fuel flowing into the breather pipe reaches the vapour canister and exceeds the canister capacity, the excess fuel may be discharged onto the ground (possible cause of fire).

notifications.product: Passenger cars – VOLVO V70, XC70, XC90, S60 (Electric Cooling Fan)
notifications.danger: This product poses a serious risk of fire because the Electric Cooling Fan control unit's metal cover may not have the specified corrosion protection. If this is the case, the metal cover will experience an accelerated corrosion process, which may lead to moisture ingress and electrical malfunction. Electrical malfunction of the cooling fan may result in high engine temperature generating a warning message in the Driver Information Module, high engine temperature shown in instrument gauge, the cooling fan continuously running or in extreme cases complete failure of the cooling fan. In the worst case scenario the condition may lead to a short circuit in the electrical fan unit and a local overheating of it. Should this occur it might initiate a fire in the engine bay. During driving the driver may in such case notice smoke and/or smell. Furthermore, the firewall between the passenger compartment and the engine bay is designed to help provide the driver with sufficient time to handle the vehicle to a safe stop and evacuate the vehicle. However, since the fan is permanently connected to battery voltage a fire may occur also on a parked vehicle, both in key-on and key-off position. Therefore, there is a risk of potential fire spreading beyond the engine bay and the vehicle itself.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer Date of entry into force: Unknown
notifications.description: 2007 model year VOLVO V70, XC70, XC90, S60 vehicles. notifications.type_numberOfModel: Motorcycles, model YZF MT 03 ‘06. The recall concerns 2006 model year YAMAHA YZF MT 03 ’06 motorcycles.
notifications.danger:
In affected motorcycles, high-pressure washing or long usage in rainy conditions can cause water infiltration inside the main wiring harness’ protection. This water could remain for a long time inside the wiring harness area, which is U-shaped and trickle down into the TPS wire through a joint. This could cause a corrosion problem, especially inside the TPS coupler. As a consequence, the TPS signal could be disturbed causing incorrect ignition advance and injection timing to occur, with one or more of the following symptoms:
- engine difficult to start;
- bad engine response; or - muffler overheating that may cause certain plastic parts to melt and/or muffler damage.
These symptoms (especially the second one) could lead to loss of control of the motorcycle.
Moreover, this product poses a serious risk of injuries because breakage of the side stand bracket may occur when the product is placed on its stand and the stand is then used as a pivot and during transport. No breakages have occurred whilst the product has been ridden. The breakage is caused by stress concentration due to bracket shape and its fixing structure. Breakage of the side stand bracket could cause side-fall of the motorcycle, resulting in possible injury of the rider. During transportation on a trailer/van/truck, an accident is possible due to instability of the machine after breakage.
notifications.measures:
Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer

notifications.name: Honda Civic passenger car
notifications.danger: The car poses a risk of injury because water present in fuel pump connector at time of connection of the harness coupler causes rapid corrosion of the pump electrical terminals. In such a case, the pump terminal fails and the fuel pump stops so the car engine does not start. If the vehicle is in motion when this happens, the motor engine will stop abruptly, yielding an increased danger of a car accident. The rapidity and the probability of the corrosion depend on the temperature and the humidity of the atmosphere. The higher the values of these two parameters are, the more rapidly the corrosion will occur. The high quantity of electrical charges accelerates the corrosion. The corrosion is not easily noticed by eye, since the terminals are covered with plastic cover. If the corrosion is not perceived in time, the car engine stops abruptly, since the pump fails to provide fuel to the engine.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer. Date of entry into force: Unknown

notifications.name: Toyota Yaris, Yaris Verso, Prius
notifications.danger: Due to loss of control of the vehicle, the product poses a risk of accident. Given the improper moulding of the resin body of the crankshaft position sensor installed on the engine block, engine oil may penetrate the seal and enter the sensor wiring connector. In this condition, engine oil inside the sensor wiring connector could cause expansion due to the heat of the engine and could deform the sensor wiring connector. In the worst case, the connector may become disconnected, which could cause the engine to stall while driving and not be able to be restarted.

The gearbox may fail to lock when the gearshift lever is put into the parking position “P”, which could lead to the vehicle moving if the handbrake is not activated.
In the case of the Discovery 3, in addition to this defect, the vehicle is equipped with xenon headlights without the system of automatic dynamic height control that is required by law. The rolling away of the vehicle when in the parking position may lead to collisions with other vehicles or pedestrians and cause traffic accidents. The lack of automatic dynamic height control for the xenon headlights of the Discovery 3 could reduce visibility for the driver or blind other vehicles, thereby increasing the risk of accidents.

notifications.danger: The motorcycle’s down sensor ensures that the engine cuts out when the motorcycle goes down. If the bolts become loose, the down sensor may come out of its bracket, causing the engine to cut out while the motorcycle is being ridden or preventing the engine from cutting out if the motorcycle goes down. If the engine cuts out while the motorcycle is being ridden, or if it fails to stop when the motorcycle goes down, this could be very dangerous and could injure or kill the motorcyclist.

notifications.danger:
This machine is extremely dangerous to operate and is likely to cause injury to the rider and to any other persons in the vicinity of the machine.
- The fuel tank is vented under and just in front of the rider of the machine, causing a situation whereby the rider will inhale petrol fumes. This is also compounded by the fact that there is a potential fire hazard if the rider of anyone nearby is smoking near the tank cap during the venting process.
- The drive chain and sprocket were not sufficiently guarded.
- Frontal chain guard that is fitted is insufficient and also has sharp edges.
- The handle bar levers were insecure, incomplete and were not ball ended.
- The exhaust was insufficiently shielded at the front.
- There was no re-set on the engine stop.
- There was no speed-limiting device present.
- A user manual provided with the mini motor bike is intended for other model.

notifications.danger: Due to various serious safety hazards, particularly regarding catching body parts/clothing in moving chain/sprocket, vapours from fuel tank and potential fire risk, product is extremely dangerous to operate from the rider’ point of view and is likely to cause injury to him/her and to any other persons in the vicinity of the product. No user instruction manual supplied with the product. Being unaware of the fact the product has no differential and of the necessary handling characteristics makes the product unsafe to operate. Chain and sprocket is almost completely unguarded. Fuel tank is vented via the fuel cap, directly in front of the rider, causing a situation whereby the rider will inhale petrol fumes. There is also a potential fire hazard if the rider of anyone nearby is smoking near the tank cap during the venting process. The engine shut-off control does not have additional action to re-set after use. The product has no mechanical suspension adversely affecting the riders' control of the machine.

In such an event, unintended vehicle motion may occur, resulting in a vehicle crash and occupant or pedestrian injuries.

notifications.danger: null The defect only concerns vehicles in which the intermediate steering shaft was fitted as a replacement part. As a result, in the event of an accident where the airbags are deployed, there might be an increased risk of injury for the passenger.

- Model Code: WAR20.
notifications.danger: null Under certain conditions condensation in the intake air corrodes the needle bearing housing, thus, the sealing between intake air and the electrical actuator circuit of the throttle body might not be water-tight any more. If water enters in the throttle body actuator circuit, the water might cause a throttle body position misreading or short circuit inside the throttle body electrical actuation mechanism. This might trigger the engine to stall while driving.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Importer Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users Date of entry into force: Unknown

There is consequently a risk of the bolts breaking which could lead to other components being damaged. notifications.productionDates: Vehicles manufactured between 2014 and 2015 are affected.

notifications.name: Juke
notifications.type_numberOfModel: 2015 model year Nissan Juke F15 vehicles equipped with 1.5 Liter DCi (K9K) Euro6b+ engine, Type Approval No.: e11*2007/46*0132*21
notifications.danger: null An incorrect calibration setting in the Engine Control Module (ECM) software may cause miscalculation of sulfur oxide (SOx) levels captured within the Lean NOx Trap (LNT) component of the exhaust’s Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF). This miscalculation could, with extended operation under certain driving conditions, affect the purge process applied to remove SOx particles from the DPF-LNT. In this condition, the capacity of the DPF-LNT may become saturated and, as a result, the nitrogen oxide (NOx) emissions from the vehicle could exceed the permitted level.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Distributor Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users Date of entry into force: 18/02/2016
notifications.productionDates: Vehicles produced from 28/05/2015 to 05/10/2015

There is also a risk of the underbody panelling catching fire.

notifications.danger:
null The subject vehicles are equipped with a “hybrid” type front passenger air bag inflator which contains compressed gas and propellant in the same combustion chamber. The burst disk in some inflators may have been improperly welded and/or misassembled. If this occurs, the disk membrane could burst only from the stored pressure of compressed gas in the inflator, allowing the gas to escape without a deployment command. This could result in the partial inflation of the front passenger air bag.
An airbag that inflates in this manner can, under some circumstances, increase the risk of injury and the possibility of a crash.

notifications.productionDates: The affected vehicles were manufactured between 21 April 2016 and 08 August 2019.

notifications.name: GLE
notifications.danger: The functioning of the front passenger airbag may be impaired by extreme vehicle interior temperatures (above 85°C). notifications.name: GLE

Consequently, condensed water could enter the passenger compartment and damage or short-circuit several electric components, causing the engine to stop or run in emergency mode while driving, increasing the risk of accident.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users Date of entry into force: Unknown
notifications.description: Passenger car under Mercedes-Benz Recall code: 8391101
notifications.productionDates: The affected vehicles were manufactured between 23 August 2018 and 5 August 2019.

notifications.name: First Class PU
notifications.danger:
The plastic of the product contains an excessive amount of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs), notably benzo[a]anthracene (BaA), chrysen (CHR), Benzo[a]pyrene (BaP), benzo[b]fluoranthene (BbFA), benzo[e]pyrene (BeP), benzo[k]fluoranthene (BkFA) and benzo[j]fluoranthene (BjFA) and (measured values: 75 mg/kg, 71 mg/kg, 15 mg/kg, 15 mg/kg, 13 mg/kg, 11 mg/kg and 9.3 mg/kg by weight respectively). These PAHs may cause cancer and are also mutagenic and toxic for reproduction.
The product does not comply with the REACH regulation.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator to whom the measure(s) were ordered: Distributor Category of measure(s): Withdrawal of the product from the market Date of entry into force: 09/11/2019

notifications.name: Proace
notifications.danger:
The rear brake tube is not tightly connected to the holding clip on the lower suspension arm. As a result, it may become damaged and leak brake fluid, reducing the braking performance of the vehicle and increasing the risk of accident.
The shaft of the parking brake might have been incorrectly manufactured. As a result, the parking brake might not properly function and the vehicle might unintentionally move, increasing the risk of accident.
The fuel tube can move against the ribs of the urea tank. As a result, it may become damaged and leak fuel, which might get ignited, increasing the risk of fire.
An insufficient torque might have been applied to the seat belt fixation, seat belt anchor and ground cable bolts. As a result, the seat belt fixation and anchor might become loose, increasing the risk of injuries in the event of an accident or the ground cable might overheat, increasing the risk of fire.
The mastic in the front left and right wheel arch panels might been applied incorrectly. As a result, water could filter and reach the airbag module, increasing the risk of accident or injuries in the event of an accident.

Compliance with the statutory requirements in force for protection by an airbag in the event of an accident is thus not ensured. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

Physical damage to the Secondary On-Board Diagnostic Control Module A (SOBDM) and/or the SOBDM connector could allow water ingress to the module which may cause an electrical short.
A short in the SOBDM can potentially cause one or more battery cells to overheat, increasing the risk of fire.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users Date of entry into force: 02/07/2020
notifications.productionDates: The affected vehicles were manufactured between 1 July 2019 and 31 July 2020.

notifications.name: Civic, CR-V and HR-V
notifications.danger:
Due to inappropriate molding conditions, the density of the resin for the low-pressure fuel pump impeller is reduced, causing it to swell and deform by the fuel. Consequently, the impeller interferes with the pump cover and makes the fuel pump inoperative.
As a result the engine may stall, increasing the risk of an accident.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Importer Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users Date of entry into force: Unknown
notifications.description: Model codes: Civic (FC1, FK6, FK7, FK8), CR-V (RT5, RT6, RW1, RW2), HR-V (RU1). Countries of production: México, Japan, Turkey and United Kindom.
notifications.productionDates: The affected vehicles were manufactured between 2018 and 2019.

notifications.name: HR-V, Jazz
notifications.danger:
Due to improper adjustment of the assembling equipment, some springs were installed in the rear seat belt retractor locking mechanisms in a bent state.
As a result, the seat belt may not be locked when it is pulled out quickly, increasing the risk of injury in the event of an accident.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Importer Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users Date of entry into force: Unknown
notifications.productionDates: The affected vehicles were manufactured in 2020.

notifications.name: E-Class, S-Class, G-Class, AMG GT
notifications.danger:
The elastomer material of the oil feed line for the exhaust-gas turbocharger may not comply with the specification, allowing oil to leak out.
Consequently, the leaking oil could come into contact with hot components, increasing the risk of fire.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users Date of entry into force: Unknown
notifications.productionDates: The affected vehicles were manufactured between 7 May 2018 and 23 October 2019.

This could lead to the seal and, potentially, neighbouring components starting to smoulder, increasing the risk of fire.

If a gas generator ruptures, the airbag would then have no restraining function and loose parts from the gas generator could reach the vehicle interior. This would increase the risk of injury for passengers.

As a result, smoke from the DCDC converter can be vented into the passenger compartment, and where sufficient oxygen exists, a sustained vehicle fire may occur.

This increases the risk of injuries to the occupants. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users Date of entry into force: 19/11/2024

notifications.name: Corolla
notifications.danger: Due to the programming of the skid control's electronic control unit software, the brake fluid pressure can be incorrectly controlled when the brake pedal is applied during cornering. This can lead users to experience a hard brake pedal with reduced braking force, increasing the brake stopping distance and creating a risk of accidents and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Importer Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users Date of entry into force: Unknown

notifications.name: CRF1100
notifications.danger: Due to improper setting of the programme in the Electronic Control Module, the wheelie control function can malfunction. When the user operates the throttle to accelerate, the wheelie control function can activated. This can affect the throttle response and result in a lack of acceleration. This can cause the rider to fall, creating a risk of injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of two- or three-wheel vehicles and quadricycles.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Importer Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users Date of entry into force: 20/11/2024

notifications.name: S-Class
notifications.danger: In the event of an independent hardware failure, the lambda control in the Engine Control Unit (ECU) software can erroneously increase the amount of injected fuel during cylinder deactivation. As a result, exhaust temperatures can increase and this can damage surrounding components (e.g. engine wiring harness, catalytic converter). This can create an unexpected loss of propulsion, increasing the risk of accidents and injuries. Moreover, this can increase the risk of fire. In addition, local statutory exhaust emission limits could be exceeded. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users Date of entry into force: Unknown

notifications.name: MY22 FXRST (Low Rider El Diablo), MY22-24 FXLRST (Low Rider ST)
notifications.danger: Due to improper bending of the brake lines during assembly, the front brake lines can come into contact with the fuel tank. This can lead to a breach in the brake lines and a loss of brake fluid. If brake fluid loss remains undetected, front braking may be compromised, increasing the risk of an accidents and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of two- or three-wheel vehicles and quadricycles.

The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

notifications.danger: The tyres can suffer from irregular wear, which can cause the tyre's cords to fail. This can lead the tyres’ tread to become detached and/or to a sudden loss of air pressure. notifications.name: AURIS TMUK, C-HR TMMT, COROLLA TMUK, NX200, RX300
notifications.danger: Insufficient pressing of parts in the high pressure fuel pump can cause movement of the cylinder in the fuel pump through which the piston moves. This can create wear between the cylinder and the pump body, resulting in increased stress on valves and/or movement valve seat inside the pump body. This increased stress can cause a crack in the weld of the affected valves, which could lead to a fuel leak, increasing the risk of fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Importer Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users Date of entry into force: Unknown

The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

notifications.name: GSX1300R (HAYABUSA)
notifications.danger: Due to an oil additive in the membrane, the primary sleeve in the master cylinder has become swollen and can block the bore. Cooling of the brake fluid can cause a drop in the pressure within the braking system, leading the brake-calliper pistons to be drawn inwards. This can cause greater play in the brake lever. The brake lever can come into contact with the throttle, resulting in an increase in braking distance. This can increase the risk of accidents and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of two- or three-wheel vehicles and quadricycles.

notifications.name: Civic

This compromises the connection's seal and can cause an electrolyte leakage. This can lead the terminals to crack, rendering the vehicle inoperable due to electrical failure. If the battery remains live, a spark can occur, posing a risk of a vehicle fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

The wheel bolts or threads may have been damaged when fitting the aluminium rims. This can result in the rims loosening while driving. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

notifications.danger: The three aluminium screws of the steering box may corrode due to exposure to spray water and aggressive road-grit (salt) used for melting ice. Advanced corrosion could weaken the screws, leading to potential breakage during manoeuvring or parking. If all fixing screws fail, the power-assisted steering could detach, resulting in a loss of power steering and an increased risk of an accident. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

notifications.name: SOUL
notifications.danger: Due to a brake fluid leak, an electrical short circuit can occur during vehicle operation. This can cause an electrical overload in the ABS module, leading the Hydraulic Electronic Control Unit (HECU), to remain live even when the vehicle is switched off. If moisture enters the HECU, an electrical short circuit can occur. This could result in an engine compartment fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

notifications.danger: A hydrogen leak can occur between the tank’s outer cover and the protective lining. If the vehicle’s hydrogen sensors detect the leak while driving, the fuel-cell system will shut off. The vehicle will then only run in electric (battery) mode, with a very limited range of about 30 km and no ability to recharge hydrogen on board. If the vehicle is parked, the hydrogen sensors do not operate. In this case, hydrogen could build up under the vehicle which increases the risk of hydrogen catching fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
